name: Dagoran
loreTies: Source: Tuatha Dé Danann/Dagda (divine tribes, sovereignty, abundance)
shortBackstory: Dagoran is the root-crown defender of Avalora — the Dagda-source whose sovereignty grows from the earth itself. He does not hold the line; he grows it.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Dagoran was born from the root-crown — the deep earth authority that says 'this ground is claimed, and the claim is living.' He is the defender whose power grows from the terrain itself. Ancient humans saw him as the Dagda — but they saw the abundance and missed the sovereignty.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Tuatha, Dagoran is the ground. His root-crown authority makes the terrain itself a member of the faction. He does not stand at the front line; he IS the front line, because the front line is the earth.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Dagoran by killing his roots. The Hollow removed patches of earth — un-creating them. His root-crown found gaps where roots simply stopped, leading to nothing.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Roots Below the Gate, Dagoran's root-crown creates living terrain that fights for the faction. His root-iron shield staff grows defensive walls from the earth. But the Hollow creates dead earth — patches where roots find nothing.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Dagoran's flaw is that he treats everything as soil to be tended — including people. His care is genuine but also controlling. The Hollow teaches him that some things cannot be grown — they can only be protected while they grow themselves.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
